production_claim_requires: a named deployed version or immutable source revision
automated tests for the claimed interface
a verified integration or smoke-test result
security and privacy review for data and side-effect boundaries
policy.rule: A repository, README, green build, design contract, or planned connection does not by itself establish runtime integration.

components.name: Ecosystems Loofy control plane and decision module
components.role: Canonical portfolio map, integration contracts, governance, and internal decision-algorithm prototype.
interfaces: Read-only stdio MCP server at adapters/decision-mcp/ for allow-listed pure decision capabilities
known_gaps: The portfolio map is a contract and inventory, not a deployed cross-system controller.
The decision module is not yet exposed as a versioned EL-Rouji service or MCP tool.
No production deployment, SLO, full security audit, or hard resource isolation is claimed.
The decision MCP server is a separate local process; no configured MCP host currently connects it to the EL-Rouji assistant.
The adapter uses cooperative deadlines and bounded inputs, not hard process-level timeouts or a hostile-code sandbox.

evidence.claim: Repository validation and package test/build workflow passed; this does not prove production integration.
Decision algorithms, workflow/portfolio controllers, examples, and tests are present.
A separately packaged MCP adapter exposes a fixed list of pure capabilities; repository CI must pass before this code is considered accepted.

components.name: EL-Rouji assistant application
components.role: Primary multilingual assistant UI and hosted API.
known_gaps: The most recent connected AppDeploy check reported ready status for snapshot 1792849620557 and no QA errors, but not every endpoint or user journey was independently exercised.
The research route has no route-local requireAuth middleware in the inspected source; its intended public/private policy and server-enforced cost/rate limits require an explicit review.
Direct page scraping is disabled in the inspected deployed source; query-based search still depends on a correctly configured server-side Tavily key.
Full account isolation, retention/deletion, and production security verification remain release gates.

evidence.claim: Connected AppDeploy status reported ready at snapshot 1792849620557 on 2026-10-25; this is a platform status result, not an exhaustive end-to-end test.
Source of truth for current API handlers; compare with the deployed snapshot before release.

components.name: EL-Rouji MCP adapter
components.role: Local MCP stdio adapter for selected EL-Rouji HTTP API endpoints.
known_gaps: The configured upstream API calls and local CI are documented, but a live end-to-end MCP-to-deployed-API test was not found in inspected evidence.
Generation-related tools are disabled by default and must remain opt-in until cost, privacy, and rate controls are verified.
This adapter does not provide arbitrary local-file access, device control, scheduling, or commerce operations.

evidence.claim: CI run 5 passed configuration and server-import checks.
The adapter exposes a bounded allow-list of upstream API calls.

components.name: EL-Rouji e-commerce specification
components.role: Commerce product requirements, draft API contracts, schemas, and proposed architecture.
interfaces: Draft checkout request and response schemas
known_gaps: No runnable storefront, commerce API, database, inventory service, payment adapter, or fulfillment integration is present at the inspected baseline.
Market, currency, payment, shipping, tax, identity, return, and refund decisions remain open.
Do not expose purchase, checkout, or payment tools in EL-Rouji until the commerce backend exists and is independently security-tested.

evidence.claim: Contract validation passed; this validates draft schemas and examples rather than live endpoints.

components.name: EL-Rouji jobs design
components.role: Requirements and architecture for future durable jobs and scheduling.
interfaces: Proposed bounded dispatcher and named handlers
known_gaps: No queue, scheduler, worker, job API, cron configuration, or durable job store is implemented in this repository.
A runtime choice and bounded due-job selection strategy require evidence before implementation.
Do not advertise scheduled or autonomous future execution until a concrete handler and end-to-end tests exist.

evidence.claim: The current document explicitly labels the subsystem not implemented.
Candidate AppDeploy-native design is proposed, not approved or deployed.

components.name: EL-Rouji dataset governance
components.role: Dataset catalog, provenance/licensing policy, manifests, and validation templates.
known_gaps: No production dataset artifact is present or verified as collected, licensed, approved, or released.
No training pipeline or production evaluation consumer is connected to the core application.
A dataset must not be used for training or redistribution solely because it is approved for evaluation.

evidence.claim: Dataset governance/template validation passed; no data-quality claim follows from this.
Catalog entries are proposed data families, not released datasets.

components.name: ARTEMIS Android automation runtime
components.role: Android/device automation runtime with its own MCP server and accessibility helper package.
known_gaps: No verified connection to the EL-Rouji MCP adapter or this portfolio's controller has been found.
Phone/device capabilities require separate authorization, explicit user approval for consequential actions, device scoping, logging, and kill/cancel behavior before orchestration.
Repository size and tests do not establish successful operation on the user's specific phone or Android configuration.

evidence.claim: Repository includes runtime, MCP, diagnostic, accessibility-helper, and test components; this portfolio audit did not establish a linked deployment.

components.name: Minna agent runtime and field kit
components.role: Separate pre-alpha Kotlin agent safety core and survey/research field kit.
interfaces: Policy, approval, egress, capability execution, and evidence storage
Python survey rendering and analysis tools
known_gaps: The Kotlin build was not independently rerun in the inspected repository-status report.
Field-kit self-test did not complete in the prior verification environment, and the kit explicitly says it is not ready to field.
No shared API or runtime bridge to EL-Rouji is documented.

evidence.claim: The repository records import success but incomplete package-level verification.
The M0 runtime is explicitly pre-alpha.

components.name: OS Diablo business-operations governance
components.role: Architecture, backlog, release governance, and risk records for a separate business-operations assistant.
known_gaps: This repository does not contain the referenced business-management application implementation.
No verified runtime, database, model pool, or connector is connected to EL-Rouji through this repository.
Do not merge its execution or authorization assumptions into EL-Rouji without reviewing the actual source application.

evidence.claim: Repository README describes a documentation-first control plane, not the executable application.

connections.interface: MCP stdio tool calls translated into fixed HTTP requests to documented /api/* routes.
required_gates: Run a live health call through MCP against the intended deployment.
Run chat, research, and text analysis with generation explicitly enabled only in a controlled test.
Verify timeout handling, response-size bounds, error redaction, provider cost, and cancellation semantics.

connections.interface: An isolated stdio MCP server now wraps a fixed allow-list of pure capabilities. Connecting it to EL-Rouji requires an explicitly configured host/orchestrator; no direct assistant/backend binding is claimed.
required_gates: Pass repository CI for the adapter and its bounded input/output/runtime tests.
Verify MCP tool discovery and calls through a real stdio host using synthetic bounded inputs.
Choose and document how an assistant host routes to the separate decision server; do not imply the web app directly calls MCP.
If a deployed service is chosen, add authentication, authorization, transport protection, monitoring, and deployment rollback before exposing it remotely.
Keep only side-effect-free, retry-safe capability IDs allow-listed; reject workflows, arbitrary code, shell commands, and network/file operations.

connections.interface: Future host-orchestrated MCP connection; no direct device-control endpoint is currently claimed.
required_gates: Register only reviewed device tools and device targets.
Require explicit approval for consequential device actions and keep read-only tools separate.
Enforce one-use approvals, timeouts, cancellation, audit records, and safe behavior on uncertain results.
Test on a controlled device before enabling the connection.

connections.interface: Future commerce API and optional AI assistance after a runnable commerce backend exists.
required_gates: Implement and deploy server-owned catalog, inventory, cart, orders, identity and audit boundaries.
Choose supported payment and fulfillment methods and verify provider credentials/webhooks.
Enforce server-side price recomputation, idempotency, ownership checks, and reconciliation.
Add end-to-end tests before exposing purchase-related assistant tools.

connections.interface: Future bounded, owner-scoped job API with named server-defined handlers.
required_gates: Choose a concrete first job type and a bounded queue/claim design.
Specify owner identity, lifecycle, retry, idempotency, cancellation, time-zone and retention semantics.
Prove due-job queries remain bounded at representative volume.
Test duplicate delivery, restart, unknown outcomes, cancellation races, cross-owner denial, and rollback.

connections.interface: Future opt-in evaluation harness and versioned evaluation artifacts, not runtime prompt injection.
required_gates: Release at least one versioned synthetic/approved dataset with provenance and checksum.
Define separate permissions for evaluation, retrieval, training, and redistribution.
Add a reproducible evaluator and store summary evidence without private conversation data.
Keep projects separate until a specific shared capability and non-duplicative boundary is justified.
Keep projects separate until the referenced executable application is available for inspection and a concrete integration is justified.
